The '''Judicial Forces''', '''Judicial Security''', '''Judicial Fleet''', or '''Judicial Starfleet''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|peacekeeping forces]] of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. For a thousand years following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the closest thing to a centralized military.

==History==
===The Ruusan Reformation===
Following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] at the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], the entirety of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], including the [[Republic Army]], [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] were to be dissolved entirely while the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] was placed under the jurisdiction of the new [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]], along with the limited peacekeeping forces that used to be the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. These were reformed into the Judicial Forces.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The Reformation was an unprecedented, voluntary dismantling by the Republic government of centralized authority over economic, political and military power. The once-mighty Republic Navy became a comparatively small collection of [[Task Forces|task forces]] and rapid response fleets, intended to patrol the frontier and respond to crises. Local defense would be handled by the [[Planetary Security Forces]], which for fourteen millennia had been little more than an auxiliary of the Navy. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] could authorize the Judicial Forces to requisition military units from systems and sectors, and in the event of a crisis, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] had the right to appoint a [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] to coordinate a military response with the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of that sector.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Members of the Judicial Forces wore close-fitting, dark-blue uniforms (whose design would later become the basis for the uniforms of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]), and consequently became known as "bluecoats". Despite its limitations, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] would regularly deploy the Judicial fleet against pirate bands and other threats to the Republic (such as during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]); as such, along with its police and intelligence capacities, the Judicial Forces were the closest thing to a standing military the Republic had following the Ruusan Reformation.

===Reunifying the galaxy===
The Judicial Forces were, with the rest of the Department, based in the [[Judicial Arcology/Legends|Judicial Arcology]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It operated the Republic's former military academies (such as the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] and the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]), as well as its own, the [[Judicial Academy/Legends|Judicial Academy]]. It coordinated its various peacekeeping efforts with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and regional planetary or sector defense militias.

The Judicial Forces' first commander was [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lune Banjeer]], a distinguished veteran of the [[Ruusan campaign]]. The Judicials fought with distinction in the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]] that brought [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] back under Republic control in the aftermath of the Sith Wars, achieving notably victories at [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]], [[D'rinba IV]] and the [[Klina sector/Legends|Klina Marches]]. They fought ably at the surface [[Confrontation on Korvaii|confrontation]] on [[Korvaii]] that ended the [[Melusi Uprising]], and brought the [[Belderone Contention]] to an end at the [[Battle of the Dandrian Ring]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The Judicial Fleet would later play key roles in the [[Mandalorian Excision]] of [[738 BBY]], the [[Battles of the Black Delve]] in the [[690s BBY]], and the [[Utor Shock]] of [[602 BBY]], with many officers serving with distinction as the galactic frontier pushed Rimward once again.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===Decline and eclipse===
As peace settled over the galaxy however, and the period that would be remembered as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] began, the Judicial Forces slowly began to lose relevance. Periodic bribery scandals and a weakening of central power eroded the Judicials' funding and standing as many Senators focused more on their sectors' Planetary Security Forces. Furthermore, the PSFs developed traditions of their own, and took over much of the appeal and glamor of military service from the Judicials, especially after they cooperated to restore the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Republic Navy War College]] on [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] as the College of the Planetary Security Forces.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

As Anaxes once again became the center of naval tradition and pomp, the [[Judicial Academy/Legends|Judicial Academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was mocked as a factory for court officers who got to fly. The [[Katana fleet]] was an attempt to restore the Judicial Forces to some of its old glory, but it turned into an expensive fiasco when the force of 200 [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] fell victim to a [[hive virus]] and disappeared without a trace into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] failed [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], many of their security forces were transferred to the Republic's Judicial branch,<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> but as the Republic entered its final decades and the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] slowly eroded its authority, [[Militarists/Legends|Militarists]], [[Reformist]]s and [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalists]] called for the restoration of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], and looked to Anaxes for models, not Coruscant.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

After the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Judicial Fleet once more became the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], while its ground peacekeeping forces were absorbed into the [[Republic Army]]. However, the new Navy's traditions, leaders and even favored [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] were drawn from the Planetary Security Forces, not the Judicials.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

By the time of the Galactic Empire's reign, the Judicial Fleet had some degree of reverence, at least in so far as the various [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] branches ultimately having some connection to it. However, the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] looked down upon the Judicial Security forces, remarked them as feeble, and stated they did not compare at all to the group.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
